data.name: Siddiqsons Tin Plate Limited
data.description: Siddiqsons Tin Plate Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on January 29, 1996 as a public limited company by shares under the Companies Ordinance 1984, repealed by the Companies Act, 2017. The principal activity of the Company is manufacturing and sale of tin plates, cans and other steel products.
